title: Naturality of normalized scalar units
statement: For two algebra extensions of the same ring sheaf and normalized scalar derived presentations, any coefficient module map given sectionwise by an algebra map carries the first scalar unit to the second under scalarUnderlyingMap, on every unbounded derived object.

source.place: Tags 07A4, 0G7E and 06YU; scalar-unit refinement with sites-modules.tex Tag 03EL; parent proof steps 1–6.

proof.text: On a resolving complex choose the K-flat single-tensor comparison, natural in the coefficient module. The two-resolving-factor normalization determines its composite with the scalar underlying isomorphism by cancellation of a second coefficient resolution.
The normalized scalar units identify their composites with the scalar counit evaluation. Conjugate the single-tensor naturality square by these evaluation and ordinary tensor isomorphisms.

The ordinary square sends m tensor one to m tensor the image of one. Ring maps preserve one, so the square commutes. The resolving-class extensionality theorem extends the equality to all derived objects.

proof_origin.place: Explicit formalization of the parent scalar/unit refinement of Tags 07A4 and 0G7E.

theorem scalar_unit_natural
    {B' : Sheaf K CommRingCat.{u}} (a' : R ⟶ B')
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (Modules.{u, u, u} B')] [ExactRestriction a']
    (s : ScalarDerivedPresentation.{u, w} a) (t : ScalarDerivedPresentation.{u, w} a')
    (psi : B ⟶ B') (h : coefficient a ⟶ coefficient a')
    (hh : ∀ (V : Cᵒᵖ) (b : B.obj.obj V), h.val.app V b = psi.hom.app V b)
    (M : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u, u} R)) :
    s.adj.unit.app M ≫ (scalarUnderlyingMap s t h).app M = t.adj.unit.app M
